deviations: importInTx start point per device = hash of local row (device, first_seq-1) when the file does not begin at seq 1 (== local head for incremental imports), instead of 'local current head' only; otherwise a full re-import of an already-present ledger could not be idempotent (UT-LR-061).

two-device golden: device B first imports A's phase-1 ledger (so B does not bootstrap its own policy.switched), then both devices act independently; B's whole ledger is merged back into A (A's rows = duplicates). Brief said 'each in its own DB' - see escalation.

Checkpoint heads/anchor `seq` are >= 1 (JSONL header devices schema); an empty ledger yields devices {} (root = sha256('{}')).

escalations.detail: Two devices that each bootstrap their own policy.switched (DB-01 §5 ②, key 'policy:<ps>') collide on the UNIQUE idempotency_key when merged: the remote device's seq-1 row is ignored, breaking its chain (importInTx correctly returns chain_broken). ADR-011 §7 does not say how to merge devices that independently created the same keyed first event. Golden two-device avoids it (B imports A first). Needs T1 decision before IT-03 multi-device merge (e.g. new device seeds from merged ledger / policy key rule).
